definitions.name: aura_cron_add
definitions.description:
Create a scheduled job and start its run

Stores a prompt or workflow start that later runs unattended with the owner's authority. The owner picks the destination of its output; a call from the agent always uses the owner destination.

workflow.description: workflow or routine id to start instead of a prompt

definitions.name: aura_cron_delete
definitions.description: Soft-delete a job and retain its history

definitions.name: aura_cron_list
definitions.description: List jobs with their next fire instant

definitions.name: aura_cron_pause
definitions.description: Pause a job after its in-flight turn settles

definitions.name: aura_cron_resume
definitions.description: Resume a paused job and restart its run

definitions.name: aura_cron_run_now
definitions.description: Record a manual fire and start the job run

definitions.name: aura_cron_runs
definitions.description: List occurrence history for a job

definitions.name: aura_kb_add
definitions.description:
Ingest a document into a collection

Reads Markdown, plain text or HTML from an https URL, a file in the workspace or an attachment of this session and stores its text as searchable chunks. An address you choose is fetched from this host.

source.description: a file path in the workspace, artifact:<id> of an attachment of this session, or an https URL

definitions.name: aura_kb_check
definitions.description: Verify the knowledge index against its content

definitions.name: aura_kb_embed
definitions.description:
Send a collection's chunks to the embedding provider for vectors

Opts the collection in to sending its chunk text to the configured embedding provider and stores the vectors; it also rebuilds vectors after the model or destination changed.

definitions.name: aura_kb_list
definitions.description: List collections that have sources

definitions.name: aura_kb_refresh
definitions.description:
Re-read the stored sources of a collection

Reads again the sources already stored in the collection. A source that cannot be read keeps its stored chunks and is reported; a stored attachment never changes; a workspace file is refreshed from the CLI or the agent and a file on the host only from the CLI.

source.description: stored source uri as kb show lists it

definitions.name: aura_kb_remove
definitions.description: Remove a source and its chunks from a collection

source.description: stored source uri as kb show lists it

definitions.name: aura_kb_show
definitions.description:
Show the sources of a collection

Source labels and addresses come from documents and pages, not from the owner.

definitions.name: aura_kb_unembed
definitions.description: Clear a collection's embedding opt-in and erase its vectors

definitions.name: aura_memory_forget
definitions.description:
Preview or delete recall documents

Deletes recall documents of one session, one document by id, or the ones a query finds; exactly one of session, id and query is required. The preview lists the documents that would be deleted and the delete removes exactly those. Conversation history is not touched.

session.description: forget every document of this session id

query.description: forget the documents this text finds

limit.description: maximum documents in the preview and the delete

definitions.name: aura_memory_inspect
definitions.description:
List recall documents with their provenance

Lists what Aura remembers from past conversations, with session, range, trust label and expiry. The content comes from conversations and tool results, not from the owner alone.

session.description: only the documents of this session id

query.description: only the documents this text finds

definitions.name: aura_memory_purge
definitions.description:
Preview or delete expired summary documents

Deletes summary documents past their expiry, the cleanup the server also runs on a timer. The preview lists the documents that would be deleted and the delete removes exactly those.

definitions.name: aura_operation_search
definitions.description: Find Aura operations by words or by group and load the ones you can call. Results also give the aura command of operations only the owner or the host can run.

definitions.name: aura_profile_delete
definitions.description:
Preview or delete a profile fact

Deletes a profile fact so it is never injected again and keeps a tombstone of the deletion. The preview names the fact and the delete removes exactly that fact.

definitions.name: aura_profile_list
definitions.description:
List profile facts

Lists the learned and owner-set facts with status, confidence and origin. The values come from conversations, not from the owner alone.

definitions.name: aura_profile_reject
definitions.description:
Reject a profile fact

Rejects a fact so it is no longer injected into owner turns.

definitions.name: aura_profile_review
definitions.description:
List facts that need review, conflicts first

Lists candidates and unverified active facts that wait for the owner, the ones that conflict with a verified fact first. The values come from conversations, not from the owner alone.

definitions.name: aura_profile_set
definitions.description:
Set a profile fact

Records a fact with origin agent. It is not verified and is not injected into owner turns: it waits in the owner's review with the learned facts until the owner accepts it. You cannot verify a fact yourself.

definitions.name: aura_profile_show
definitions.description:
Show one profile fact with its provenance

Shows a fact with its status, origin, conflicts and the evidence it was learned from. The value comes from conversations, not from the owner alone.

output_files.description: Relative file names written under the output/ directory of the working directory. Each existing regular file is imported as an artifact.

definitions.name: workflow_cancel
definitions.description: Cancel a workflow run by run id.

definitions.name: workflow_list
definitions.description: List the workflows you may start.

definitions.name: workflow_propose
definitions.description: Propose a workflow for the owner to approve; nothing runs until they do. Send spec with goal and steps. Each step has an id, an executor, and optional depends_on, condition and retry. Executor kinds: tool runs a registered tool with args matching that tool's schema; agent runs one read-only turn of persona agent_id over its dependencies' outputs; approval waits for the owner; wait pauses for an event; workflow runs another workflow. An agent step's tools come from read_file, list_dir, web_search, web_fetch, and may not mix workspace tools (read_file, list_dir) with web tools. A step with web tools may not depend on a private step: any tool step other than web_search and web_fetch, an agent step with workspace tools, or an agent step downstream of one. A tool step that changes things needs an approval step among its predecessors. Example: {"spec":{"goal":"Summarize the latest Go release news","steps":[{"id":"search","executor":{"kind":"tool","tool":"web_search","args":{"query":"Go release news"}}},{"id":"summary","depends_on":["search"],"executor":{"kind":"agent","agent_id":"main","prompt":"Summarize the search results in five bullet points."}}]}}

condition.description: steps.<id>.status or steps.<id>.output.<key> compared with == or != to a literal, joined by &&

definitions.name: workflow_save_routine
definitions.description: Save the workflow of a succeeded run as a named routine the owner can start again.

definitions.name: workflow_start
definitions.description: Start a workflow by id, optionally with an objective. Returns the run id; read progress with workflow_status.

definitions.name: workflow_status
definitions.description: Show the status of a workflow run and its steps.
